verdict.rationale: Extend has dedicated Classification and Splitting overview docs plus async processing that applies to every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse), and supports file upload with automatic conversion, indicating a workflow where a single multi-document upload can be classified/split into per-document outputs. Community feedback confirms satisfaction with extraction accuracy over a year of production use. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end worked example combining classification+splitting on one upload with per-document result output shown in a single doc, and independent hands-on verification of this exact multi-doc splitting workflow.
